sources.title: Qwen3-235B-A22B model card
sources.evidence: Original hybrid-thinking checkpoint: nominal 235B total and 22B active; 32,768 native context, validated to 131,072 using YaRN; tool calling supported.

sources.title: Qwen3-235B-A22B config.json
sources.evidence: Qwen3MoeForCausalLM, qwen3_moe, 94 layers, 128 experts and 8 experts per token. max_position_embeddings is 40,960; rope_scaling is null.

sources.title: Qwen3: Think Deeper, Act Faster
sources.evidence: April 29, 2025 release announcement explicitly names Qwen3-235B-A22B and publishes its 235B total/22B active MoE size and open-weight availability.

sources.title: Qwen3 official repository and release news
sources.evidence: Lists original series release on April 29, 2025; separately dates 235B Instruct-2507 to July 21 and Thinking-2507 to July 25.

sources.title: Qwen3-235B-A22B LICENSE
sources.evidence: The exact checkpoint repository supplies the Apache License, Version 2.0.

sources.title: Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507 model card
sources.evidence: Separate July non-thinking checkpoint; native context 262,144, with documented extension to 1,010,000. These limits do not redefine the original checkpoint.

sources.title: Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507 model card
sources.evidence: Separate July thinking-only checkpoint; native context 262,144. Its later long-context instructions belong to that revision.

sources.title: Alibaba Introduces Qwen3, Setting New Benchmark in Open-Source AI with Hybrid Reasoning
sources.evidence: April 29, 2025 announcement identifies Alibaba as developer and confirms multilingual, reasoning, coding and function-calling capabilities plus global weight availability.

sources.title: Original checkpoint commit history
sources.evidence: Includes a weight-upload commit dated April 28, 2025, and an initial commit April 27. Commit timestamps do not establish when a previously private repository became public.

name.note: Display spelling corresponds to the official Qwen3-235B-A22B checkpoint.

developer.note: Developed by the Qwen team at Alibaba Cloud; existing parent-organization label is accurate.

family.note: Qwen3 is explicitly part of the Qwen family.

release_date.note: Official release-announcement date. Baseline April 28 conflicts with three explicit developer announcements. April 28 upload metadata is real but does not prove public availability; do not silently equate upload and release dates.

open_weights.note: Original checkpoint is explicitly included in the published weights.

license.note: Confirmed directly in this checkpoint repository.

parameters_b.note: Developer-reported nominal total in billions, including embeddings; no precision beyond 235B is asserted.

active_parameters_b.note: Developer explicitly reports 22B activated parameters; independent of total count.

architecture.note: Transformer causal LM with routed mixture-of-experts layers; config specifies 128 experts and top-8 routing.

context_window.note: Validated extended limit, requiring YaRN factor 4 over 32,768 native tokens. Config defaults to 40,960 positions with no scaling; this is not native 131K context. Alibaba Model Studio enables dynamic YaRN by default.

modalities.note: Text causal LM and tokenizer-based chat interface; no vision or audio component in this checkpoint.

reasoning.note: Original checkpoint supports switching between thinking and non-thinking modes.

tool_call.note: Explicit function-calling support with Qwen-Agent templates and parsers.

description.value: Large open Qwen MoE for multilingual reasoning, coding, and tool use
description.note: Broad capability description is supported; no unsupported performance comparison is present.

patch.notes: Original April 2025 hybrid thinking/non-thinking checkpoint, distinct from Instruct-2507 and Thinking-2507. 235B total and 22B active are nominal developer-reported counts. Context is 32,768 tokens natively and validated to 131,072 with YaRN factor 4; default config has max_position_embeddings=40,960 and rope_scaling=null. Alibaba Model Studio enables dynamic YaRN by default. Release date uses the explicit April 29 developer announcement; repository uploads on April 28 do not establish public availability.

summary: Confirmed all 14 fields against primary evidence, with license added and parameter provenance upgraded. Proposed April 29 official-announcement date replaces April 28 catalog date, with upload-date ambiguity documented. Retained 131,072 as the supported extended context limit and added its YaRN requirement. Original hybrid checkpoint must not inherit July revisions’ 262,144-native context or single-mode behavior.
